lesson-intro.text: Far out in the desert stands a saguaro cactus, holding up two arms. It's a tall post, two bent arms and a few spines. Look how the arms bend, then draw yours.

body-left.text: The cactus is a tall post with a round top. From the bottom left, go straight up and curve over to the middle.

body-right.text: Carry on over the top and straight down the right side. A short flat line closes the bottom.

left-arm.text: The left arm is a letter L. From the post, go out, turn up and round over the tip.

left-arm-outside.text: Then the outside of the L: from the post again, out, around the elbow and up to the tip.

right-arm.text: The right arm sits higher and is shorter. Two lines again, inside first, both from the post.

spines-body.text: Spines are short slanted dashes. Put four down the post, leaning left, then right, in turn.

spines-arms.text: One more dash on each arm.

lesson-outro.text: Two arms up and six spines, and nobody got prickled. That saguaro is yours.
